Name: PokePets
Author: killedthecar
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever thought, "This game is cute, but it sure would be cuter with Pokémon"?

Well, here you go.

This mod replaces every single pet, farm animal, companion, and a number of mobs with Pokémon. The replacements are as follows:

This is my first foray into modding, so expect some wonkiness. Some animations might not line up correctly, some things might not make the most sense (I'm pretty sure I have Murkrow showing up outside of fall, for instance), and there are things that are possible but I do not know how to do yet. Like, for instance, adding all the cat replacers in at once.

[b][u][size=4]INSTRUCTIONS:
[/size]
[/u][/b][size=3]Unzip the file directly into your mod folder in the game directory.[/size]



[size=4][u][b]POSSIBLE QUESTIONS:

[/b][/u][/size][size=3]Q: Can you add (X) Pokémon?
A: Possibly, later on down the line, but I wouldn't hold my breath. The Pokémon currently added are ones that I thought would fit and ones that I and people I talked to wanted to see.

Q: Why isn't the rabbit one of the rabbit Pokémon?
A: Because all the rabbit Pokémon are bipedal and don't fit in the sprite "frame," and I'm entirely too inexperienced to tackle that quite just yet.

Q: Are you planning on continuing work on this mod?
A: I plan on working on it here and there, but I want to take a bit and gather feedback and, y'know, actually play the game. I feel like this is a good launching point and I want to get it out there.

Q: Is this mod compatible with (X) mod?
A: Genuinely, I do not know. I don't play with any other replacers or any of the huge overhaul mods. If you do, download this at your own risk. If you decide to take the risk and find conflicts/compatibilities, let me know and I will update the description. I can tell you right now it works with SVE, but that's the main (big) mod I play with.
